- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant notes that studies have generally focused on short-term effects, as genetically modified foods have only been widely available for a few decades, but ongoing research is being conducted.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant explains that it would be counterproductive for the food industry to promote unsafe products due to risks to their reputation and bottom line.
